scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic and stage-uniform; exact-rational finite checks supplement but do not substitute for proof. Literature comparisons cannot establish uniqueness exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: Proves positivity only for the completed Gauss endpoints on unweighted finite complete multipartite combinatorial Laplacians. It does not assert internal-stage positivity or validity on general graphs; for odd stages and N>=3 it proves eventual sign loss, not an exact loss time. For even stages the large-step map tends to the identity, so strict positivity does not establish stiff-regime accuracy.
title: An all-order parity law for Gauss-step positivity on complete multipartite heat networks
